title: Predict vertex of (x + 3)^2 + 1, then check sliders
stem_student: Before you move anything, name the vertex of f(x) = (x + 3)^2 + 1. Then set the sliders so the graph matches that equation and check.
stem_teacher: Original classroom prompt on the GeoGebra/JSXGraph analogue. Source applet description is not student copy. Fallback: locally bundled JSXGraph; do not require GeoGebra.
answer_verification: GeoGebra applet has no key. The brief’s exact (x + 3)^2 + 1 stem is not a catalogue exercise; this is a focused prompt on the selected applet (sliders p, q, a with f(x) = a(x − p)^2 + q).
